final: WITH rc AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), ca AS (SELECT City, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS city_avg FROM rc GROUP BY City), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM rc) SELECT rc.City, SUM(rc.cnt) AS total_customers, AVG(rc.cnt - ca.city_avg) AS avg_above_city_avg, AVG(rc.cnt * 1.0 / tot.total) AS avg_share FROM rc JOIN ca ON ca.City IS rc.City CROSS JOIN tot WHERE rc.cnt > ca.city_avg GROUP BY rc.City
